name: FB-SMP host
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'sudo ln -sfn /workspaces /workspace 2>/dev/null || true; if [ ! -e /workspaces/jdk25/jdk-25.0.4.1+1 ]; then JH=$(dirname "$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$(command -v java)")")"); mkdir -p /workspaces/jdk25; ln -sfn "$JH" /workspaces/jdk25/jdk-25.0.4.1+1 2>/dev/null || true; fi; if [ -x /workspaces/fbsmp-keeper.sh ]; then if ! pgrep -f fbsmp-keeper.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; then setsid nohup /workspaces/fbsmp-keeper.sh >>/workspaces/keeper.log 2>&1 </dev/null & fi; fi; true'
